blocks.text: One more thing for Friday. Our auditor will join for 15 minutes, for the PDF part. I'd put that near the middle so they're not waiting through the setup.

They asked me something I couldn't answer: if an inspector gets something wrong and it's corrected later, does the correction show up on the PDF? That's usually the first thing they look for. Paper makes it obvious, crossed out and initialed.
No need for a long answer now. Just want you to know it's coming.
